#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <random>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
const int MAXN = 11;

long long mask = (1LL << 31) - 1;

long long pow(long long a, long long n, long long mod) {
    long long ret = 1;
    int x = 63 - __builtin_clzll(n);
    for (; x >= 0; x--) {
        ret = ret * ret % mod;
        if (n << 63 - x < 0)
            ret = ret * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

long long invl(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long b = mod;
    long long p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b;
        long long d;
        d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

long long modh(long long a, long long M, int h, long long mod) {
    long long r = a - ((M * (a & mask) >>> 31) + M * (a >>> 31) >>> h - 31) * mod;
    return r < mod ? r : r - mod;
}

long long* nttmb(long long* src, int n, bool inverse, long long P, int g) {
    long long* dst = new long long[n];

    int h = __builtin_ctz(n);
    long long K = (1LL << 32) % P;
    int H = 32 * __builtin_ctz(K);
    long long M = K * K / P;

    int wws[1 << h - 1];
    long long dw = inverse ? pow(g, P - 1 - (P - 1) / n, P) : pow(g, (P - 1) / n, P);
    long long w = 1;
    for (int k = 0; k < 1 << h - 1; k++) {
        wws[k] = w;
        w = modh(w * dw, M, H, P);
    }
    long long J = invl(P, 1LL << 32);
    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 1 << i; j++) {
            for (int k = 0, s = j << h - i, t = s | 1 << h - i - 1; k < 1 << h - i - 1; k++, s++, t++) {
                long long u = (dst[s] - dst[t] + 2 * P) * wws[k];
                dst[s] += dst[t];
                if (dst[s] >= 2 * P) dst[s] -= 2 * P;
                long long Q = (u << 32) * J >>> 32;
                dst[t] = (u >>> 32) - (Q * P >>> 32) + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h - 1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 1 << h - i - 2; k++) wws[k] = wws[k * 2];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = __builtin_reverse(i) >>> -h;
        if (i < rev) {
            long long d = dst[i];
            dst[i] = dst[rev];
            dst[rev] = d;
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        long long in = invl(n, P);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in, M, H, P);
    }

    return dst;
}

long long* convoluteSimply(long long* a, long long* b, long long P, int g) {
    int m = max(2, __builtin_huge_val() / max(*a, *b) + 1);
    long long* fa = nttmb(a, m, false, P, g);
    long long* fb = a == b ? fa : nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        fa[i] = fa[i] * fb[i] % P;
    }
    return nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

void solve() {
    int N;
    cin >> N;
    int k;
    cin >> k;
    long long dig[MAXN];
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        dig[MAXN - x] = 1;
    }
    int power = N / 2;
    long long* res = new long long[1];
    res[0] = 1;
    while (power > 0) {
        if ((power & 1) > 0) {
            res = convoluteSimply(res, dig, MOD, 3);
        }
        dig = convoluteSimply(dig, dig, MOD, 3);
        power >>= 1;
    }
    long long output = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < res[0]; i++) {
        output += res[0] * res[0];
        output %= MOD;
    }
    cout << output << endl;
    delete[] res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T = 1;
    while (T--) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
